_meta.description: Model failover chain for automation scripts (weekly_brain_digest.yml, saturday_plan_generator.yml, future agent scripts) that call an LLM API. On a 429/5xx/timeout, the caller should try the next provider in 'chain' order before giving up.

chain.notes: Free tier, fast, but low rate limits (429s under moderate load).
Second choice when Groq rate-limits. Free-tier model list rotates; verify the model slug is still marked ':free' before relying on it.
Last resort, offline fallback. Requires Ollama running locally with the model pulled (`ollama pull llama3.1:8b`). No rate limits, but only reachable from this machine.
